entries.label: Followup acceptance
entries.question: Should review suggestions remain proposed until you explicitly agree, while direct requests from you become accepted immediately?

entries.label: Acceptance record
entries.question: How should followups record acceptance when publishing does not require a separate user agreement?
entries.answer: we don't need to overcomplicate things. we can just treat them the same way as the original planned changes, where if they're in the plan, the user implicitly accepts them by moving to the next phase

entries.label: Simple plan membership
entries.question: To apply the same approval model as original changes, should I remove per-followup proposed/accepted/dismissed states and user-message citations, and treat every finalized followup as agreed scope when you run the next /workflow-implement or /workflow-review?
